snippet.title: 11 Years Making a Hand Painted Puzzle Game
snippet.description:
I am making an adventure puzzle game where backgrounds are hand painted in watercolor. It has unique puzzles which are based on real languages and mathematical principles.
This is dev log #0 where I show 11 years of progress on the game and talk about my development journey.
I plan to post further updates, so please subscribe if you'd like to follow the progress!

instagram.com/dariamakesgames
